hints.JPN: 2026 年 11 月 1 日起改成先付含稅價、出境時海關確認後再退；同一店同一天不含稅 5,000 日圓以上，購買隔天起 90 天內出國；消費稅 10%
hints.KOR: 每張收據 15,000 韓元以上，購買後 3 個月內出境（稅率未核對）
hints.CHN: 同一天在同一家退稅商店 200 元人民幣以上（含增值稅），購買日到離境日不超過 90 天；增值稅 13%
hints.SGP: 100 新加坡元以上（含 GST，同一店家同一天最多 3 張收據合計），購買後 2 個月內從樟宜或實里達機場出境，16 歲以上；GST 9%
hints.THA: 每張退稅申請表 2,000 泰銖以上（含稅），購買後 60 天內帶出；加值稅 7%（減徵到 2027 年 9 月 30 日）
hints.AUS: 同一家商店（同一 ABN）合計 300 澳幣以上（含 GST），離境前 60 天內購買（稅率未核對）
hints.GBR: 大不列顛（英格蘭、蘇格蘭、威爾斯）的旅客退稅隨脫歐過渡期結束取消，2021 年 1 月 1 日起不能退；北愛爾蘭還有；加值稅 20%
hints.CAN: 訪客退稅（Visitor Rebate Program）已取消，現行的消費稅法不讓個人旅客退 GST（2007 年改成只給會議與團體旅遊的方案）；GST 5%
hints.FRA: 超過 100 歐元（含稅），購買月份之後第 3 個月結束前在海關驗章，16 歲以上；海關兩頁的算法寫得不同（同店同一天／同品牌 3 天內）；加值稅 20%
hints.DEU: 每張收據超過 50 歐元（含稅），購買月份之後第 3 個月結束前出境，由商家退；加值稅 19%
hints.ESP: 2018 年起沒有最低金額，交貨後 3 個月內帶出；加值稅 21%
hints.NLD: 合計 50 歐元以上（含稅），購買月份後 3 個月內帶出；加值稅 21%
hints.CHE: 至少 300 瑞士法郎（含稅），90 天內帶出，由賣方退；加值稅 8.1%
hints.VNM: 有（財政部 2026 年 7 月發布新的旅客退稅規定）；門檻、期限、稅率未核對
hints.IDN: 門檻看的是稅額：可退的加值稅合計 50 萬印尼盾以上（每張發票的稅至少 5 萬），出境前 30 天內購買（稅率未核對）
hints.TUR: 同一張發票不含稅超過 1,000 里拉，發票日起 3 個月內帶出（稅率未核對）
hints.NZL: 沒有旅客退稅（只能在免稅店買，或由商家直接寄出國外免 GST）；GST 15%
hints.PHL: 2024 年立法（RA 12079），施行細則 2025 年 3 月 24 日簽署：認可商店 3,000 披索以上、購買後 60 天內帶出；2025 年 11 月還在遴選退稅業者，實際開始退稅了沒有未核對
hints.TWN: 同一天在同一家特約商店含稅 2,000 元以上，購買日起 90 天內出境；現場小額退稅同一天同一家 48,000 元以下（單次來台累計 12 萬、同一年 24 萬元為限）。關務署統計：2006 年 94,570 人次、退稅 9,702 萬元，2015 年最多 64.3 萬人次、16.2 億元，2019 年 39.1 萬人次、8.0 億元，2020 年起因疫情幾乎歸零（開放資料只到 2021 年，2021 年 723 人次）

hintsEn.JPN: From 1 November 2026 shoppers pay the tax-inclusive price and get the tax back after customs checks on departure; ¥5,000 or more before tax at one shop in one day, leaving within 90 days of the day after purchase; consumption tax 10%
hintsEn.KOR: KRW 15,000 or more per receipt, leaving within 3 months of purchase (VAT rate not checked)
hintsEn.CHN: CN¥200 or more (VAT included) at one tax-refund shop in one day, leaving within 90 days of purchase; VAT 13%
hintsEn.SGP: S$100 or more including GST (up to 3 same-day receipts from one shop), leaving via Changi or Seletar within 2 months; aged 16 or over; GST 9%
hintsEn.THA: THB 2,000 or more (VAT included) per refund form, taken out within 60 days of purchase; VAT 7% (reduced rate extended to 30 September 2027)
hintsEn.AUS: A$300 or more including GST from one business (same ABN), bought within 60 days before departure (GST rate not checked)
hintsEn.GBR: Abolished in Great Britain (England, Scotland, Wales) at the end of the Brexit transition period: no refunds from 1 January 2021; still available in Northern Ireland; VAT 20%
hintsEn.CAN: The Visitor Rebate Program was eliminated: the current Excise Tax Act gives individual visitors no GST rebate (replaced in 2007 by a programme for conventions and tour packages only); GST 5%
hintsEn.FRA: Over €100 including tax, validated by customs before the end of the third month after purchase; aged 16 or over; two customs pages count it differently (one shop in one day / one brand within 3 days); VAT 20%
hintsEn.DEU: Over €50 including VAT per receipt, leaving before the end of the third month after purchase; refunded by the shop; VAT 19%
hintsEn.ESP: No minimum since 2018; goods taken out within 3 months of delivery; VAT 21%
hintsEn.NLD: €50 or more including VAT, taken out within 3 months after the month of purchase; VAT 21%
hintsEn.CHE: At least CHF 300 including VAT, taken out within 90 days; refunded by the seller; VAT 8.1%
hintsEn.VNM: Yes (the Ministry of Finance issued new tourist refund rules in July 2026); threshold, deadline and rate not checked
hintsEn.IDN: The threshold is on the tax itself: refundable VAT of at least Rp500,000 in total (at least Rp50,000 per invoice), bought within 30 days before departure (rate not checked)
hintsEn.TUR: Over TRY 1,000 before tax on one invoice, taken out within 3 months of the invoice date (rate not checked)
hintsEn.NZL: No tourist refund (only duty-free shops, or goods exported directly by the seller zero-rated); GST 15%
hintsEn.PHL: Legislated in 2024 (RA 12079), implementing rules signed on 24 March 2025: PHP 3,000 or more at accredited stores, taken out within 60 days; refund operators were still being selected in November 2025, and whether refunds have started was not checked
hintsEn.TWN: NT$2,000 or more including tax at one participating shop in one day, leaving within 90 days of purchase; on-the-spot refunds for up to NT$48,000 per shop per day (NT$120,000 per visit and NT$240,000 per year). Customs statistics: 94,570 refunds worth NT$97 million in 2006, peaking at 643,237 worth NT$1.62 billion in 2015, 391,393 worth NT$0.80 billion in 2019, and almost none from 2020 because of the pandemic (open data end in 2021)
